sqlite3 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db "SELECT DISTINCT type FROM event ORDER BY type;" && echo "=== sequences ===" && sqlite3 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db "SELECT aggregate_id, seq, owner_id FROM event_sequence;" && echo "=== sessions ===" && sqlite3 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db "SELECT id, directory, title, datetime(time_updated/1000,'unixepoch'), time_updated FROM session ORDER BY time_updated DESC LIMIT 5;"
sqlite3 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db "SELECT seq, id, type, substr(data,1,300) FROM event WHERE aggregate_id='ses_e6cdbc1a0ffeB35p1XUBugASS7' AND type LIKE 'session%' ORDER BY seq;"
sqlite3 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db "SELECT seq, type, data FROM event WHERE aggregate_id='ses_e6cdbc1a0ffeB35p1XUBugASS7' ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 3;"

sqlite3 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db "SELECT data FROM event WHERE aggregate_id='ses_e6cdbc1a0ffeB35p1XUBugASS7' AND seq=0;" | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "=== message.updated sample ==="; sqlite3 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db "SELECT data FROM event WHERE type='message.updated.1' ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1;" | head -c 600

sqlite3 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db "SELECT 'max_seq', max(seq), 'total', count(*) FROM event WHERE aggregate_id='ses_e6cdbc1a0ffeB35p1XUBugASS7'; SELECT 'event_sequence', seq FROM event_sequence WHERE aggregate_id='ses_e6cdbc1a0ffeB35p1XUBugASS7'; SELECT 'has_timestamp_field', count(*) FROM event WHERE data LIKE '%\"timestamp\"%';"; echo "=== log grep ==="; grep -iE "reset|recovery|hook|container" ~/.local/share/opencode/log/opencode.log | head -20; echo "=== log tail ==="; tail -20 ~/.local/share/opencode/log/opencode.log

ls -la ~/.cache/opencode/bin/ ~/.local/share/opencode/repos/ ~/.local/state/opencode/locks/ 2>/dev/null; for f in ~/.cache/opencode/bin/*; do echo "== $f =="; strings "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -ciE "container_reset|runtime_recovery" || echo "0 matches"; done

sqlite3 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db "SELECT type, count(*) FROM event GROUP BY type; SELECT '---'; SELECT key, substr(value,1,120) FROM migration LIMIT 10;" 2>/dev/null; sqlite3 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db ".schema data_migration" ".schema session_context_epoch" 2>/dev/null
